Thanks for waiting, we have an answer now (which is not at all what I was expecting): Modifiers apply to one effect die, and the character who created the mod decides what effect to apply it to.  So Unity is going to choose to apply it to the damage roll in this case, making it 5 damage (and still a -2 Hinder to whatever survives).
